sources.label: Standalone, app-specific patches for use with Morphe
sources.author: kveld9 Extra
patch_list: Neutralizes Google AppMeasurement, Firebase Analytics, and Firebase Crashlytics event dispatchers at bytecode entrypoints.
Bypasses the com.nxp.mifare system feature check in SUBE so the app runs on devices whose ROM does not declare NXP Mifare support.

Rewrites the Firebase Installations API endpoint (firebaseinstallations.googleapis.com) to 0.0.0.0 in DEX bytecode across all classes, severing background FID registration and installation auth tokens. WARNING: Breaks push notifications (F…
Disables Firebase Cloud Messaging services and instance ID receivers in AndroidManifest.xml. Breaks push notifications and FCM background delivery.
Strips advertising permissions, disables measurement services, providers, and install receivers, and injects opt-out metadata flags in AndroidManifest.xml.
